reason: ARTEMIS can now decide when and how to route subagents across Codex, Claude Code and Antigravity CLI without launching them.

observed_contract: subagents use TOML fields such as name, description, prompt and optional tools
explicit invocation can reference the agent by name
subagents are Markdown files with YAML frontmatter
Claude can delegate proactively from descriptions and can be invoked explicitly
subagents can be long-running or asynchronous
subagents inherit parent scopes and permissions
ARTEMIS must treat inherited scopes as a human-gated risk

socratic_gate.question: What is the single outcome the subagent must produce?
Why is a subagent better than doing the task in the current session?
socratic_gate.required_evidence: parallelism, isolation, specialist capability or latency reason

socratic_gate.question: What exact files, directories or APIs may the subagent touch?
socratic_gate.required_evidence: read scope, write scope and forbidden scope

socratic_gate.question: Can this task run without depending on another active writer?
Which provider fits the task shape and why?
socratic_gate.required_evidence: provider id, model policy and rejection of unsuitable providers

socratic_gate.question: What validation proves the subagent result is acceptable?
socratic_gate.required_evidence: commands, expected outputs and artifact checks

socratic_gate.question: What token, time and concurrency limits apply?
socratic_gate.required_evidence: budget policy, max duration and stop condition

socratic_gate.question: Could this touch secrets, remote state, auth, money, production or inherited broad scopes?
socratic_gate.required_evidence: approval id or explicit dry-run/no-side-effect proof

socratic_gate.question: What should the subagent hand back if it succeeds, fails or gets blocked?
socratic_gate.required_evidence: STATUS, VALIDATION, HANDOFF and blocker escalation format

provider_profiles.runtime_surface: Codex native subagents and Codex terminal/app-server lanes
best_for: longer reasoning with strict repo evidence
avoid_for: multiple writers on the same worktree
provider_profiles.artemis_launch_rule: Use for high-value engineering slices after Socratic Gate passes and write ownership is explicit.

provider_profiles.runtime_surface: Claude Code subagents and SDK/headless lanes
best_for: fast exploration before Codex executes a larger slice
provider_profiles.artemis_launch_rule: Use for short-to-medium specialist slices with frequent checkpoints and exact handoff expectations.

avoid_for: remote writes without explicit human gate
provider_profiles.artemis_launch_rule: Use only after inherited scopes are displayed and approved; default to dry-run until permissions are narrow.

routing_rules.then: do not launch; ask the human or refine the Exec Pack
assign exactly one writer and one worktree before launch

routing_rules.if: task is complex, multi-file, validation-heavy or architectural
routing_rules.then: prefer Codex subagent or Codex terminal owner

routing_rules.if: task is repository mapping, language orientation or bounded medium implementation
routing_rules.then: prefer Claude Code subagent with short checkpoint

routing_rules.if: task is asynchronous, long-running or provider-specific experiment
routing_rules.then: prefer Antigravity only with inherited-scope review and dry-run gate

routing_rules.if: task touches auth, secrets, remote state, production, money, broad permissions or push
routing_rules.then: block launch until a recorded human decision exists

routing_rules.if: subagent returns changes or claims completion
routing_rules.then: run validation gate and capture evidence before Done Ledger

blocked_until_next_cut: start provider runtimes from the portal

checks.evidence: Antigravity profile blocks broad inherited scopes behind Human Gate.
